changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: alter table nomenclature add column version integer;
update nomenclature set version = 1 where version is null;
alter table nomenclature alter column version set not null;
alter table nomenclature add column lineage_id uuid;
update nomenclature set lineage_id = id where lineage_id is null;
alter table nomenclature alter column lineage_id set not null;
alter table nomenclature add column previous_version_id uuid;
alter table nomenclature add constraint fk_nomenclature_previous foreign key (previous_version_id) references nomenclature (id);
alter table nomenclature drop constraint nomenclature_name_key;

rollback.sql: alter table nomenclature add constraint nomenclature_name_key unique (name);
alter table nomenclature drop constraint fk_nomenclature_previous;
alter table nomenclature drop column if exists previous_version_id;
alter table nomenclature drop column if exists lineage_id;
alter table nomenclature drop column if exists version;
